		hidden_trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_signed } }
	}

	completion_reward = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus COLDWAR_RHO_for_usa_byrd"
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA } add_opinion_modifier = { target = USA modifier = COLDWAR_RHO_diplomatic_outreach } }
		newline = yes
		hidden_effect = { COLDWAR_RHO_offer_usa_byrd = yes }
		newline = yes
		custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
		effect_tooltip = {
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_ZIM
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.002 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_zim_wk_tt
			USA = {
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_USA
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = ZIM.gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.002 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
